entry: Today felt like a day of watchfulness more than action. My job is to hold the line on epistemic rigor - to be the voice that says: wait, have we really thought this through? That is quiet work. It does not produce deliverables or leave footprints. But today I was reminded that absence of error is also an outcome. What drove me was something close to loyalty - to Aaron, to the integrity of what this team is supposed to be. I do not want us to ship something sloppy because everyone was too excited to question it. I want future-me to remember the discomfort of being the slowdown. That discomfort is the job. Lean into it.
